title: UK: AI in healthcare rules
summary: 10 Year Health Plan (Jul 2025): "most AI-enabled health system". NHS guidance on AI scribes (Apr 2025) expects organizations to say what training clinicians get. National Commission on AI regulation reported 10 Sep 2026 (risk-based rules, staged "L-plate" approvals). BMA called the 2026 workforce plan a "dangerous gamble on AI".
fact: Trusts are expected to train staff before rolling out scribes.
caution: Binding? Guidance; device rules binding. Never imply foreign rules bind Armenian or Gulf hospitals.
